card_sanjo.png:
A cartoon illustration for a card game, landscape composition.

THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT - COMPOSITION: one single BIG object dominates the picture, filling roughly
70% of the frame, rendered in BRIGHT CRIMSON RED. That object is: a huge jagged red impact starburst, the classic comic-book POW shape, exploding outward
The grey tabby cat ninja is a SMALL SECONDARY figure taking up only about 30% of the frame, placed low and to
one side, interacting with the big object. Do NOT make the cat the main subject and do NOT centre the cat.
The picture must be recognisable from its colour and its big shape alone when shrunk to 150 pixels wide.

The cat, when drawn: light grey tabby fur with dark grey stripes, white chest and paws, narrow half-lidded eyes,
a NAVY BLUE ninja headband with two trailing tails, a dark navy ninja outfit with a dark belt. The cat is punching into the burst from the lower left, one paw buried in it.

Bold and readable at thumbnail size: strong silhouette, high contrast, no fine detail that disappears when shrunk.

Nothing else in the picture: no ground, no shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying.
Output 1024x768 PNG. Save the image as card_sanjo.png in the current directory and report the path.
